title: limnia cordifolia
intro: Limnia cordifolia, commonly known as Red Cordia or Cordia, is a plant species belonging to the Buxaceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Limnia cordifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including cordia drupacea, cordia latifolia, and cordia myxa, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
